terminals.name: dev-server
terminals.command: bash /workspace/.cursor/start.sh && cd /workspace && source .venv/bin/activate && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && manage runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
terminals.description: Django development server (gyrinx.settings_dev) on http://localhost:8000. Ensures PostgreSQL is up first (start.sh is idempotent) so the server has a database even if the per-boot start step has not run yet.
